subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Which memory roles and per-agent semantics should OpenClaw publish as the durable first version of this plugin contract?
rationale: Recall, capture, compaction, dreaming, and user modeling currently have different levels of invocation-protocol maturity, while this PR would make all five names public compatibility commitments.

options.title: Narrow to mature roles
options.body: Land only roles with complete invocation semantics and add the others alongside dedicated protocols.

options.title: Adopt all five roles
options.body: Accept the full taxonomy now and document which roles are hook-only or protocol foundations.

options.title: Pause for RFC
options.body: Wait for the linked RFC to settle role names, lifecycle ownership, and scoping semantics.

recommendation.title: Narrow to mature roles
recommendation.body: Land only roles with complete invocation semantics and add the others alongside dedicated protocols.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice spans product architecture, public configuration, and the plugin SDK boundaries established in Peter Steinberger's prior work.
